sources.reading_scope: APPROX/RANDOM 2023, LIPIcs 275, 31:1–31:20; §1, PDF pp.2–3: full truth-table input, threshold at most its length, membership in NP and the explicit NP-hardness/BPP questions.

STACS 2026, LIPIcs 364, 23:1–23:19; §1, pp.23:2–23:4: AND/OR/NOT basis, total-gate versus binary-gate size conventions, ordinary total MCSP and partial variants; main result for XOR simple extensions.
CCC 2023, LIPIcs 264, 31:1–31:25; §1.1, Theorems 1 and 3 and Proposition 2: restricted sum-of-squares refutations of the circuit-existence encoding.

FOCS 2025 proceedings author copy; Theorems I.1 and V.7: conditional deterministic quasipolynomial-time nonadaptive reductions, including constant-factor approximation; all three assumptions are required.
ECCC TR26-091, 4 June 2026; abstract and §1: ordinary MCSP is distinguished from implicit-input gap MCSP and its conditional randomized reductions.
